I’m incorporating those applicable combinations into the verifier now, with explicit exclusions only for icons/colors and out-of-scope Git, extended-attribute, owner/group, and Unix metadata features.

+def power_cases(fixture: Path) -> list[tuple[str, list[str]]]:
+    excluded = {
+        "--icons", "--color", "--colour", "--git", "--no-git",
+        "--git-repos", "--extended", "-@", "--links", "-H",
+        "--blocksize", "-S", "--group", "-g", "--inode", "-i",
+        "--mounts", "-M", "--numeric", "-n", "--octal-permissions",
+        "-o", "--context", "-Z", "--hyperlink", "--smart-group",
+    }
+    result: list[tuple[str, list[str]]] = []
+    for path in sorted((ROOT / "rust-reference/tests/ptests").glob("*.toml")):
+        data = tomllib.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        argv = shlex.split(data.get("args", ""), posix=True)
+        options = argv[1:]
+        if any(token.split("=", 1)[0] in excluded for token in options):
+            continue
+        result.append((path.name, ["--color=never", "--icons=never", *options, str(fixture)]))
+    return result
